procs.name: Flow 1 - EDI orders (automatic)

inbox: Trigger

procs.outnote: EDI: sales, return and rebate orders, created automatically - straight to billing, no credit check

steps.t: SAP processes the EDI file
steps.d: The distributor's daily EDI sales file interfaces into AZ's SAP. SAP processes the file, creates the sales, return and rebate orders automatically and runs three checks before the order can proceed: customer, price and stock.
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02

pp: Missing end-customer accounts

steps.d: SAP needs a valid price condition for the product and customer before it can value the order.

procs.name: Flow 2 - Customer PO, returns and rebates (manual)
procs.owner: O2C Sales Order team, checks run by SAP
inbox: Trigger
Customer sends a purchase order, return or rebate claim
procs.outnote: Manual: sales order, or credit note for a return / rebate - after the system credit check

steps.t: Receive PO, return or rebate request
steps.d: The customer sends the request directly to AZ by email or the customer portal and the Sales Order team picks it up. A purchase order is a new sale ("Dear AZ, please supply 500 units"). A return or rebate is not a sale - it is money going back to the customer: the hospital returns expired medicines, or the agreement says buy 10,000 units and get 5% back.
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02
in: Purchase order, return or rebate claim
Return or rebate request raised by the market

steps.q: Approval obtained for rebate or return?
steps.d: Returns, rebates and non-standard orders (sample, FOC zero value) need the approval before anything is created in SAP. A standard purchase order needs no approval and continues.
steps.ex: Return of expired stock approved by the market; 5% rebate approved under the agreement
steps.yes: Continue to step 2 - enter the order or credit note in SAP
steps.no: Reject the request back to the requester
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02; register controls 1-3
steps.note: No approval is required for sales orders

steps.t: Process Order / Credit note in SAP
steps.d: A person creates the sales order (or, for a return or rebate, the credit note) in SAP instead of SAP creating it automatically. A credit note is a negative invoice: the invoice said the customer owes AZ RM10,000; the credit note says AZ owes the customer RM1,000. SAP then checks the credit limit.
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02
pp: Manual order creation
Missing customer accounts
Missing pricing
Incorrect VAT setup
steps.ci: Completed: Python script automates Alexion order processing, returns and rebates. WIP: Global CN dashboard
steps.ctl: Approval checks for EDI credit notes, manual credit notes and non-standard orders (sample, FOC zero value)

steps.q: Pass system credit check for sales order?
steps.d: Would the new order take the customer over its credit limit? Manual orders go through the system credit check; EDI orders do not.
steps.ex: Customer owes RM90,000; limit RM100,000; new order RM20,000 - total RM110,000 is over the limit
steps.yes: Within the limit - sales order / credit note created
steps.no: Over the limit - the order is held and goes to phase 2, Order block release, for review and approval
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02

frames.lead: SAP processes the daily distributor EDI file; the Sales Order team fixes missing end-customer accounts, prices and stock. Customer POs, returns and rebates are entered manually after approval, then pass the system credit check.

procs.name: Order block release (manual orders)
procs.owner: SAP credit check; Order Release, Credit Risk and Collection teams on blocks
inbox: Trigger
Manual sales order enters the SAP credit check
procs.outnote: Released for delivery (goods issue) and then billing - the end of this phase

steps.t: System credit check on manual orders
steps.d: Every manual order (not EDI) goes through the SAP credit check. SAP blocks the order if the customer's credit limit is exceeded, the account has an overdue balance, or the payment term has changed. The Order Release team works the blocked-orders list daily.
steps.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02; register O2C-01.03
pp: High volume of order blocks in CNXX markets
steps.ci: WIP: system change to exclude Banker's Acceptance from the CNXX credit exposure (go-live Q4 2026)

branches.ex: Customer owes RM90,000; limit RM100,000; new order RM20,000

step.d: The Credit Risk team reviews the exposure and obtains the approval required under GDOA 2002, then passes the evidenced approval to the Order Release team for release.
step.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02; register O2C-01.03

branches.ex: Invoices past due on the customer account

step.d: The Collection team reviews the overdue position and obtains approval in accordance with the Global Credit Risk Policy, then passes it to the Order Release team for release.
step.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02; register O2C-01.03

branches.ex: Payment term moved from 30 to 60 days

step.d: The Credit Risk team reviews the payment-term change and obtains approval in accordance with GDOA 2000, then passes it to the Order Release team for release.
step.src: O2C Sales Order team walkthrough (Oct 2026); register O2C-01.02; register O2C-01.03

steps.t: Release the order on approval
steps.d: The Order Release team releases the blocked order once the appropriate approval is evidenced. The released order goes to Distribution for delivery (goods issue) and then to Billing.

steps.t: Automatically match payments to invoices
steps.d: High Radius automatically matches customer payments to invoices based on the remittance advice or configured matching rules, including FIFO clearing for the China and Korea markets.
steps.src: O2C register (Oct 2026), row O2C-02.04 Payment allocation; Cash Application walkthrough note

steps.d: Did High Radius match the payment to the paid invoice(s)? If yes, HRC posts the clearing to SAP (step 3). If no, the Cash Application team checks and clears the payment manually (step 4).
steps.ex: Remittance advice quotes the invoice paid = matched; a lump-sum receipt with no remittance = unmatched
steps.yes: Step 3 - generate the payment output file and post to SAP
steps.no: Step 4 - manual check and clear in High Radius / SAP
steps.src: O2C register (Oct 2026), row O2C-02.04 Payment allocation; Cash Application walkthrough note

fix.t: Manual check & clear in High Radius / SAP
fix.d: The Cash Application team manually checks the payment that High Radius could not match, then clears it in High Radius and SAP (including China / Korea advance payments and other exceptions).

steps.t: Generate output file and post to SAP
steps.d: Once matching is completed, High Radius generates the payment output file and interfaces it to SAP. The payment is cleared against the corresponding invoice in the customer account.

steps.d: Is the bank statement an electronic MT940 / CAMT53 statement interfaced from the bank? If yes, SAP posts the statement and clears the open items automatically (step 2).
